title: GraphQL N+1 and the cost of nested resolvers
summary: Why GraphQL turns one HTTP request into 1000 database calls, how DataLoader fixes it with a single event-loop tick, and the complexity / depth / persisted-query controls that keep public APIs alive.
crux: One GraphQL query of 1+N rows fires 1+N DB trips. DataLoader collapses them to 2. Every other GraphQL defence builds on that fix.
keytakeaway: GraphQL N+1 is the cost of independent resolvers. DataLoader batches per request. Layer depth, complexity, persisted queries and introspection-off to keep the API alive.
